firstPlayerRule: The most enthusiastic worker is Monday’s first Shift Supervisor.
clarifications: The Shift Supervisor reveals and places one Product tile after the team discusses where it belongs.
The role rotates clockwise after each tile.
During the final customer rush, the whole team searches simultaneously.

sources.title: Wilmot's Warehouse — English rulebook

internalEvidence: Downloaded and rendered the CMYK-branded employee handbook. Printed/PDF page 10 assigns Monday’s first Shift Supervisor to the most enthusiastic worker; page 12 explains their job and clockwise turns, while pages 13 and 16 distinguish role rotation from the simultaneous final customer rush. The publisher credits appear on page 18. SHA-256: d2a080b6c1d60ef5cbe03baf160b4360529212e63edf97fa23c95d4a0de55d29. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the cited opening instruction and edition against the rulebook.
uncertainty: “Most enthusiastic” is subjective. The criterion selects a rotating cooperative role and is excluded from the portable random mix.
